visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a black crop top and black cargo pants, is squatting outdoors on a gray rubberized playground surface. She energetically holds an orange smartphone directly toward the camera lens while smiling broadly. In the background, metal climbing structures and green trees are visible under natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of the orange smartphone lying on a wooden table. A human hand is placed flat next to the device to demonstrate its physical dimensions relative to a person's palm. (3) The woman is sitting on a gray sofa in an indoor studio environment with a white brick wall background and orange decorative pillows. She gestures toward the phone's screen while talking. (4) Close-up shots detail the back of the device, highlighting three large circular camera lenses arranged in a triangular pattern and a metallic side frame with buttons. (5) The woman appears in a park setting, seen through the phone's digital camera interface as she waves her arm from a long distance. (6) The video shows a screen recording of a mobile game being played horizontally with thumbs moving across the interface. (7) Returning to the playground, the woman squats low, then falls backward onto the rubber matting while laughing hysterically, as the camera pans up toward the playground equipment.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: iPhone 17 Pro Max. (2) [Subtitle]: 你必知的四大亮點. (3) [Subtitle]: 6.9吋螢幕. [Subtitle]: 跟我的手比起來 差不多大. (4) [Subtitle]: Super Retina HDR 顯示器. [Subtitle]: HDR 峰值亮度 高達 3,000nits. (5) [Subtitle]: 在大太陽底下 螢幕還是很亮 看影片完全沒問題. (6) [Subtitle]: 進擊的三眼怪. (7) [Subtitle]: 主鏡頭 超廣角鏡頭 望遠鏡頭 全都是 4,800 萬畫素. (8) [Subtitle]: 8 倍光學品質長焦 數位變焦 甚至能到 40 倍. (9) [Subtitle]: 我跑到很遠 還是可以拍得很清楚喔. (10) [Subtitle]: 再來是性能強悍的 A19 Pro 晶片. (11) [Subtitle]: 6核心 CPU 6核心 GPU 16核心的神經網路引擎. (12) [Subtitle]: 玩遊戲都不卡卡 而且還很省電喔. (13) [Subtitle]: 一體成型鋁合金工藝 還塞下均熱板 讓散熱效果更好. (14) [Subtitle]: 重點是儲存空間 2 TB 是歷代以來最高. (15) [Subtitle]: 不過定價 NT$72,900 也是歷代以來最高 你買單嗎. (16) [Subtitle]: 我買不起.
